evidence: Labeled P2P, touches test/functional/p2p_opportunistic_1p1c.py, and fixes transaction relay handling in peer reject filters.
rationale: Prevents evicted package transactions from being placed into peer reject filters where they cannot be reconsidered before the next block. Reviewers emphasize this is relevant for p2p 1p1c package relay, ensuring an evicted parent can be reconsidered when announced with a higher-fee child.
